Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: barrel wear
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Every shot wears the barrel down. When it is worn out the gun stops firing until a colonist fits a new one: machine guns use steel, cannons and mortars use reinforced barrels made at the lathe. The barrel gizmo shows the shots left and lets you choose how early the barrel is replaced.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: hand-loaded shells
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Fires mortar shells that the crew loads by hand. The loaded shell decides the effect: high-explosive, incendiary, EMP, smoke and so on. Keep shells stocked nearby and set which ones may be used in the gun's storage settings.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: shell types
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This gun can switch shell type with its ammo gizmo, for example armor-piercing against machines and high-explosive or airburst against infantry. Switching is instant, followed by a short pause to reload. Only the projectile changes: no ammo items are used and barrel wear is the same for every type.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: suppression
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Hits from this weapon, and its heavy shell blasts, give shell shock to every creature they hurt, friend or foe. Shell shock builds up under sustained fire, bringing pain, dulled senses and eventually mental breaks; in the first and the acute stage the victim moves faster in a panic. It wears off over about a day. Machines are immune. Keep your own people out of the fire zone.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: concrete grades
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description:
Concrete comes in three grades for different jobs.
- Concrete: cheap and plentiful, twice the hit points of the base structure but twice as slow to build. For long walls.
- Prefab concrete: 1.5 times the hit points and builds as fast as wood. For quick works under pressure.
- Rebar concrete: 2.5 times the hit points, three times the build time. For positions that must hold.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: sandbag cover
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Packed earth soaks up small-arms fire: bullets do half damage to it and arrows only a quarter. Explosives and heavy shells hit it at full strength.
